text:
Brady Tkachuk's first season in Florida has a family flavor. He scored on the power play in St. Louis on Nov. 14, the night his brother Matthew called a tribute to their father "Icing On The Cake," per NDTV Sports. Meanwhile in Ottawa, Daily Faceoff wrote that Travis Green was "a major factor in Senators overcoming Brady Tkachuk trade."

On the ice he is the same force: 24 points in 24 games, 84 shots and 100 hits. His 11 goals on 10.8 expected (expected goals measure chance quality) say the finishing is honest, and he ranks 11th in the league in wins added. Florida takes 59% of the shot attempts at five on five with him on. The odd number is his ice time, 16:35 a night, modest for a player this productive. Evolving-Hockey had him in the 99th percentile last season for driving chances, with competition in the 93rd, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking found 19% of his setups coming from behind the net. The production looks built to last.
headline: Brady Tkachuk, Panther, is exactly himself
